concerns.text: The plan cites two separate open datasets (SMILES parquet from https://huggingface.co/datasets/maykcaldas/smiles-transformers/... and FQY JSON from https://doi.org/10.48700/vvsxc-ff833) and joins them on InChIKey. However, Functional Requirement FR-018 explicitly requires a *single verified open dataset* that already contains both SMILES strings and experimental fluorescence quantum yields (FluorDB v1.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/fluordb/v1). Using the current two‑source strategy does not satisfy FR‑018 and may introduce join‑related inconsistencies, violating the data‑resource feasibility requirement.
